entries.why: The new leaf module otto.host.limitation (#935) is loaded with otto.host.options, which declares the console's unescaped-0xFF device limitation beside the option it describes; any run that opens a host session loads it anyway through otto.host.session. site:typer: typer 0.29's new parameter modules (typer._coercion, typer._param_types, typer._adapters) replace its click type system.
